chief_complaint: Increasing shortness of breath, especially with exertion, and occasional chest tightness.
doctor_notes: Patient presents with worsening dyspnea on exertion, consistent with her history of mild heart failure. BP is elevated today. Current medications for HTN and DM are optimized. Added Furosemide for fluid management. BNP is elevated, suggesting cardiac strain. Will schedule for echocardiogram and cardiology follow-up.

conversation_summary.speaker: Doctor
conversation_summary.text: Good morning, Eleanor. What brings you in today?

conversation_summary.speaker: Patient
conversation_summary.text: Hello, Doctor. I've been feeling more and more out of breath lately, especially when I walk to the mailbox. And sometimes my chest feels a bit tight.

conversation_summary.speaker: Doctor
conversation_summary.text: I see. How long has this been going on?

conversation_summary.speaker: Patient
conversation_summary.text: It's been gradually getting worse over the past month or so. I used to be able to walk around the block without any trouble.

conversation_summary.speaker: Doctor
conversation_summary.text: Have you noticed any swelling in your legs or ankles?

conversation_summary.speaker: Patient
conversation_summary.text: Yes, a little bit, especially at the end of the day.

conversation_summary.speaker: Doctor
conversation_summary.text: Okay. Your blood pressure is a bit high today. We'll adjust your medication slightly to help with that and your symptoms.

conversation_summary.speaker: Patient
conversation_summary.text: Thank you, Doctor. I'm worried about my heart.

conversation_summary.speaker: Doctor
conversation_summary.text: We're going to do some further tests to get a clearer picture. I'll also refer you to a cardiologist.

follow_up_actions: Follow up with PCP in 2 weeks
